Subject: Renewal paperwork: order form redlines + ramp plan

Hi Ryan / Contracts team,

Thanks again for the productive call this week. Attached is our redline pass on the order form (orderform_v3_redline.xlsx) and a clean exhibit C with the proposed capacity ramp schedule (SKY-4521_exhibit_C_redline.pdf). High-level items we need to resolve before signing: 

- MSA update: data retention / audit window language (we proposed a 90-day retention carve for log exports in Section 4.2).
- SLA credits for burst capacity during ramp (Skylab asked about how we treat burst over-commit).
- Procurement timeline: your procurement ops noted they need a signed order by 11/12 to align with quarter close — can we confirm?

Quick asks: can Contracts confirm whether Skylab requires our SOC 2 Type II report or a vendor attestation plus an external auditor statement? Also, Ryan — are the exhibit C ramp dates aligned with your internal launch (we have month-by-month uplift to hit 200 GPUs by end of Q1 2027).

Proposed next step: 30-min working session Monday 11/9 10:00 AM PT to walk redlines and lock language. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite + link to the Drive folder.

Attachments: orderform_v3_redline.xlsx (redline), SKY-4521_exhibit_C_redline.pdf (clean w/ comments)

Thanks,

Naomi — thanks for the files and the clear summary. Quick notes from our side: 

- We reviewed the ramp schedule; dates look reasonable but we need to confirm internal headcount/ops support for the burst windows in Dec–Jan.
- SLA credits: our procurement teams typically look for a specific credit schedule tied to 99.5% availability baseline. Can you confirm Redwood’s proposed credit ladder for burst-related downtime?
- Audit evidence: Elena asked whether a vendor attestation + SOC 2 report is sufficient, or if Redwood can provide an auditor letter referencing the period in question.

I’ve looped in our Contracts inbox and Elena — they’ll review the MSA redlines and reply with markups. Monday 11/9 10:00 AM PT works for us — I’ll accept the invite once you send it.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@skylab.ai>, Contracts <contracts@skylab.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form redlines + ramp plan

Naomi / Karthik — I reviewed the attached MSA/Exhibit C redlines and put a short draft SLA patch into SLA_patch_DRAFT.docx.

Key legal suggestions (high level):
1) Section 4.2 (Retention & Logs): instead of a fixed 90-day carve in the MSA text, propose adding a defined "Support Retention Exhibit" (Exhibit D) that enumerates categories and retention windows (production logs: 90 days; audit logs: 180 days). This keeps the MSA cleaner and lets us update retention via exhibit amendment.

2) SLA credits for burst: recommend a tiered credit schedule tied to sustained degraded availability per billing period rather than per burst event. Draft language in SLA_patch_DRAFT.docx (see para 3). This avoids frequent micro-credits during heavy ramping.

3) Audit: recommend we offer the SOC 2 Type II report plus a written auditor confirmation for the trailing 12-month period. If Skylab requires access to auditor working papers, that will need a separate NDA and narrow scoping.

I’ll be on the call 11/9 to walk legal changes. Karthik — can you prepare an estimate for the billing impact if Skylab elects the 180-day audit log retention? I expect a small incremental storage charge but want precise numbers for the procurement team.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: SLA_patch_DRAFT.docx (internal draft with redline suggestions)

---

From: Contracts <contracts@skylab.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@skylab.ai>, Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@skylab.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form redlines + ramp plan

Hi all — thanks for the redlines. Attached is Skylab's counter-redline on Exhibit C and the order form (SKY-4521_exhibit_C_counter.pdf). A few items to highlight: 

- Retention: we can accept a 90-day production log window, but request 365 days for audit logs (our regulatory team requires twelve months for forensic needs). If Redwood is open to an audit-limited 365-day retention, we can accept the rest of the exhibit cleanly.
- Auditor confirmation: we can take SOC 2 + auditor letter; we do not expect working papers.
- SLA credits: procurement pushed back on a tiered per-month credit; they prefer a per-event credit schedule for burst incidents (example language added). Please confirm the maximum credit cap per quarter.
- Timeline: procurement needs a fully executed order form + MSA amendment by COB 11/12 to meet invoicing for December.

We attached a DocuSign template link for the current MSA if you want to run an execution trial: https://docusign.skylab.ai/exec/SKY-4521 (test link).

Best,
Skylab Contracts Team
contracts@skylab.ai

Attachment: SKY-4521_exhibit_C_counter.pdf (counter-redline)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form redlines + ramp plan — next steps

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. Summary and next steps: 

1) Retention: Redwood is willing to accept 365 days for "audit logs" but requests we keep production logs at 90 days (Marissa will formalize the exhibit amendment language during the call).
2) SLA credits: we can accept a per-event credit ladder for burst incidents but request a quarterly cap of 10% of the monthly invoice (draft cap language in SLA_patch_DRAFT.docx).
3) Auditor evidence: SOC 2 Type II + auditor letter acceptable — no need for working papers or additional NDA at this time.
4) Timeline: Naomi to run a 30-min redline walk-through now that Skylab has provided counter-redlines. Proposed meeting: Wed 11/10 10:00 AM PT — Karthik to join for billing impact and Marissa for legal.

Karthik — action item: share an updated cost estimate (delta for 365-day audit logs) by EOD 11/10 so procurement can confirm budget. Contracts team — if you can confirm acceptance of the quarterly cap on credits by EOD 11/11 we can route to signature and try to make 11/12 closing.

I’ll upload the merged redline (orderform_v3_redline_merged.xlsx) to the Drive folder and send the calendar invite for 11/10.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
